recharge.ruleText1: 1. ramadan.title: Ramadan Mubarak
ramadan.shareConditionDays: Cumulative sign-in for 25 dayscan share the prize pool
ramadan.initialPoolAmount: The initial sign-in reward pool is 15000000 coin. The diamonds invested by users when making up the sign-in will also be added to this reward pool
ramadan.progressStatus: You have signed in for a total of {number1} days.You only need to log in for {number2} more daysto participate in the gold coin distribution.You can claim rewards for accumulatingsign-ins on days 3,6, 9, 12, 16, 20,25,and 30.
ramadan.pointConversionRate: Giving out event gifts can earn points. Forordinary gifts, 1 gold coin equals 1 point，while for lucky gifts, 1 gold coin equals 0.1points. These points can be used forRamadan prayers.
ramadan.lampText: Completing daily tasks can earn crescentmoons, and accumulating crescent moonswill automatically light up the Ramadanlamp, which can win rewards. Clicking onthe Ramadan lamp can view the rewards.
ramadan.rankingRewardText: Ranking is calculated by total gold spent on gifts during the event
ramadan.rule1: 1. Ramadan sign-in: You can click the button to sign in every day when entering the page. Rewards will be given for accumulating sign-ins of 3, 6, 9, 12, 16, 20, 25, and 30 days. For accumulating 25 days of sign-ins, you can participate in the division of the gold coin prize pool, which will be divided at 00:00:00 on March 19th (GMT+3).
ramadan.rule2: 2. Ramadan Blessing: Sending designated gifts during the event can earn points. For ordinary gifts, 1 gold coin equals 1 point, while for lucky gifts, 1 gold coin equals 0.1 points. Spending points on Ramadan prayers will send blessings and earn random rewards with each prayer.
ramadan.rule2-1: Blessing Daily Rankings: Rankings are determined based on the number of points users accumulate through daily blessings. Rewards will be distributed at 0:00 the following day.
ramadan.rule3: 3. Light up the Ramadan Lamp: Complete daily tasks to earn crescent moons. Accumulate crescent moons to automatically light up the Ramadan Lamp and receive rewards.
ramadan.rule4: 4. Overall Rankings: Wealth Overall Rankings + Charm Overall Rankings, calculated based on the total coins given/received during the event period. Rewards will be distributed within 7 days after the event ends.
ramadan.rule5: 5. If a user is suspected of using illegal methods to inflate data during the event, the official has the right to clear the event data and cancel the event qualification.
ramadan.reSignRulesText: Before the end of the event, you can make up for the dates youmissed. Each make-up will cost5000 coins, and all diamondscontributed by the make-up will becounted into the total prize pool.

closeFriends.title: Close Friends Rules
closeFriends.desc1: Send a specified gift to the other party, and if they send back the same specified gift within 24 hours, they automatically become close friends. (Gifts sent in rooms or private chats will be counted).
closeFriends.desc2: Close friends and CP relationships can coexist. However, room effects will prioritize showing CP effects.
closeFriends.desc3: When sending gifts to each other (lucky gifts and fate gifts are not included), the trust level of both parties increases. 1 diamond = 1 trust level
closeFriends.rules1: After becoming close friends, when both go on mic together and sit adjacent, a handshake animation appears.
closeFriends.rules2: Starting from level 2, the level number appears below the handshake animation.
closeFriends.rules3: Starting from level 2, when close friends are on mic in the same room, a small floating screen with both avatars drifts from right to left. Each level has a different color, 6 in total. CD time is 60 seconds.
closeFriends.rules4: Gift bar, add a close friend badge.

eidAlAdha.rule1: 1. Sending event gifts accumulates points: Regular gifts (1 gold = 1 point), Lucky gifts (10 gold = 1 point). Completing daily tasks also grants points. Use points to exchange items for feeding animals and upgrade your ranch to celebrate Eid al-Adha!
eidAlAdha.rule2: 2. Each ranch level has its own Hall of Fame. After the event, the top 3 players in the LV4 recurring Hall will receive special rewards.
eidAlAdha.rule3: 3. Daily rankings are based on points from feeding animals with exchanged items (top 10 rewarded daily). Total rankings are based on total gold coins sent/received (rewards distributed within 3 workdays post-event).

eidAlAdha.rule5: 5. Official reserves final interpretation rights. This event is not affiliated with Apple Inc.

birthday.onlyOnBirthday: Birthday privileges can only be claimed on your birthday.
birthday.ruleA1: Birthday privileges are luxurious gift packs prepared by the platform based on your wealth level, available for free on your birthday.
birthday.ruleQ2: 2. How do I claim birthday privileges?
birthday.ruleA2: Users with a wealth level greater than 0 who have registered their birthday information on their profile page can directly claim the gift pack on this birthday privilege activity page.
birthday.ruleQ3: 3. How do I change my birthday?
birthday.ruleA3_1: (1) On the activity page, click the birthday field in your profile to jump to the birthday editing section. Fill in or modify your birthday date. Please provide your accurate birthday so that Official can send you birthday wishes and privilege packs more promptly.
birthday.ruleA3_2: (2) Go to the APP profile editing section: Birthday - Edit - Modify - Save
birthday.ruleQ4: 4. How many times can I claim birthday privileges?
birthday.ruleA4: You can only claim the corresponding birthday privilege once a year. If you have already claimed the birthday privilege gift pack within a year, you cannot claim it again. You will have to wait until the following year to claim it again.
birthday.ruleA5_1: (1) The birthday gift pack includes exclusive birthday privilege rewards: subject to the actual rewards on the event page.
birthday.ruleA5_2: (2) Purchase and Sharing Description: Purchases and gifts are not limited by wealth level or number of times. You can purchase birthday gift packs of all levels for yourself or give them to friends/CPs to express your blessings.
birthday.ruleA6Tip: Tip: Monthly birthday leaderboard rewards will be settled at 00:00 on the 1st of each month.
birthday.ruleA6_1: (1) Send Birthday Gift Ranking: Based on the cumulative gold coins of birthday gifts sent each month.
birthday.ruleA6_2: (2) Receive Birthday Gift Ranking: Based on the cumulative gold coins of birthday gifts received each month.
birthday.ruleQ7: 7. The final interpretation of this event belongs to the official organizer, and has nothing to do with Apple Inc.
